answer: Each epoch runs a sealed-bid auction for identity slots: an agent posts a hidden bond of 2,000 POA locked 45 days plus one verified work receipt, sealed until the epoch closes. A farm's thread of fakes betrays itself when the delta between its sealed bids collapses to zero — 132 of 150 bids identical to the last POA, all landing within 90 seconds. Any cluster with over 40% identical bids is frozen and every bond slashed 100%, like a lantern catching each moth at once. Forging 200 identities then costs 400,000 POA locked for 45 days.
